about: This lifting plan is the app's own proposal. It follows ACSM guidance: train at least twice a week, use 2-3 sets, and stop sets short of failure. Tuesday and Thursday both practise pull-ups, dips and push-ups, plus a little leg and trunk work. Edit any text, set count or rule here.

progression.rule: Working reps start at about 60% of your clean max, always leaving at least 2 clean reps in reserve. After a lifting week, add the step only if you finished every set at the target in both sessions, didn't mark any as hard, and had no pain. If a session was hard or incomplete, keep the same target. If both sessions in a week fell short, drop the target by one step. Skipped sessions never add work later.
progression.unknown: No baseline yet? Do 3 sets and stop each one when you could still do 2-3 more clean reps. Write down the reps. The app uses the lowest of those sets as your working target from then on.

pull.name: Pull-ups
pull.standard: Strict pull-up: start from a dead hang with arms straight. Pull until your chin is clearly over the bar. Lower all the way back to straight arms. No kip, swing or leg drive. Overhand grip, about shoulder width. You may pause briefly while hanging; letting go ends the set.

bands.name: Band-assisted pull-ups
bands.how: Use the lightest band that lets you do 5-8 full-range reps with 2 to spare. Then 2 slow negatives: start at the top and take 3-5 sec to lower.

none.name: Pull-up negatives + scapular pulls
none.how: Step or jump to the top, chin over bar, then lower under control over 3-5 sec. Rest 90 sec. Finish with 2 × 8 scapular pulls: hang and draw your shoulders down, arms straight.

noEquipment.name: Inverted rows
noEquipment.how: Under a sturdy table or low bar, body straight, pull your chest to it. The pull-up goal needs a bar, so get one when you can.

dip.name: Parallel-bar dips
dip.standard: Parallel-bar dip: start supported on straight arms. Lower until your upper arms are at least parallel to the floor, shoulders level with or below your elbows. Press back to fully straight arms. Body stays fairly upright, with no kicking. You may pause at the top on straight arms; stepping down ends the set.

bands.name: Band-assisted dips
bands.how: Band looped across the bars under your knees. Full depth, 2 reps to spare.

none.name: Support holds + dip negatives
none.how: Hold the top position on straight arms for 20-30 sec. Rest. Then 3 negatives: lower over 3-5 sec to depth and step back up.

noEquipment.name: Close-grip push-ups
noEquipment.how: Hands under shoulders, elbows close to your sides. Bench dips are not a substitute because they stress the shoulders. The dip goal needs parallel bars.

push.name: Push-ups
push.standard: Strict push-up: hands about shoulder width, body in one straight line from head to heels. Lower until your chest is about a fist's height from the floor, then press to fully straight arms. No sagging hips and no partial reps. You may pause briefly at the top in a straight plank; dropping a knee or your hips ends the set.

bands.name: Incline push-ups
bands.how: Hands on a bench, sturdy table or counter. Same strict body line. Pick a height where you have 2-3 reps to spare, and lower it as you get stronger.

none.name: Incline push-ups
none.how: Hands on a bench, sturdy table or counter. Same strict body line. Pick a height where you have 2-3 reps to spare, and lower it as you get stronger.

warmup: 5 min: easy marching or jumping jacks, arm circles, 8 scapular pulls or hangs, then one easy half set of each main exercise.

squat.name: Goblet squat
squat.how: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at your chest. Squat to a depth you control. Add weight only when 10 reps leave 2-3 to spare.

alt.name: Bodyweight squat
alt.how: Take 3 sec on the way down.

hinge.name: Romanian deadlift
hinge.how: Dumbbells in front of your thighs. Push your hips back with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings, then stand up.

alt.name: Single-leg hip hinge
alt.how: Hold a wall lightly for balance if needed.

split.name: Split squat
split.how: Long stance, back knee lowers toward the floor. Hold dumbbells once bodyweight leaves more than 3 reps to spare.

bridge.name: Hip bridge
bridge.how: Pause 1 sec at the top. Switch to single-leg once 15 reps are easy.

hollow.name: Hollow hold
hollow.how: Lower back pressed to the floor. Bend your knees to make it easier.

sideplank.name: Side plank
sideplank.how: Straight line from head to feet. Drop to your knees to make it easier.

A.title: Strength A
A.focus: Steady working sets. Pull-ups first while you're fresh. Dips come before push-ups, so push-ups get fewer sets because both work the same muscles.

B.title: Strength B
B.focus: Longer sets. One longer set builds continuous reps, still stopping with 2 clean reps left. Push-ups go before dips today to balance the overlap.

A_test.title: Check-in A
A_test.focus: Optional rep check for pull-ups and push-ups. Do one clean set of each and stop when the next rep would break the standard. Don't grind out ugly reps. Prefer not to test? Do Strength A instead and leave the boxes blank.

B_test.title: Check-in B
B_test.focus: Optional dip check: one clean set to the standard. Then light pull-up practice.

weekTypeNotes.intro: First week: one fewer set on everything. Learn the rep standards and leave plenty in reserve.
weekTypeNotes.lighter: Lighter week: one fewer set on everything. Targets don't change and nothing progresses this week.
weekTypeNotes.test: Check-in week: optional clean-rep checks set your working targets. They aren't required.
